'''Ryan French''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] player. On the Players Committee forum he posted as '''Shadow 13'''; according to his forum signature (captured September 2008), he was the founder of the Rebel Strike Team group.<ref name="pcf-21444-308959">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=308959#308959 Endor Regionals], Ryan French, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> In January 2004 [[David Kangas]] pointed a player from Spokane to French, "based out near Wenatchee", whose contact details were listed under [[Shadow Squadron]] on the Players Committee main page, and wrote that the Rebel Strike Team had gone quiet.<ref name="pcf-2677-40034">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40034#40034 Greetings!], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014208/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40034%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In September 2008 he wrote that when running events he used three tiers of decklist penalties: an official warning for insignificant errors (two warnings making a game loss), a game loss for significant errors, and disqualification for cheating; at the last regional or state championship he had run, two players received game losses for decklist errors.<ref name="pcf-21481-335338">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335338#335338 2008 &#91;Road to Worlds&#93; schedule, results and decklists], Ryan French (Shadow 13), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080916195941/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335091&sid=d06ad6437369bcd26a837f9f518a057c Internet Archive]</ref> His forum signature as shown on the live forum also calls him a "two-time washington state champion"; this is his own claim.<ref name="sf-20536-297158">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=297158#p297158 Washington State Championship - discussion], Shadow 13 (Ryan French), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 April 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-24994-367540">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=367540#p367540 Worlds 2000 FAQ - March 27-29th, 2009], Shadow 13 (Ryan French), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 January 2009).</ref> At the 2007 Washington State Championship, according to [[Mike French]], the two of them met at table one in round 6 to decide which of them would play in the final confrontation.<ref name="sf-20536-311053">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311053#p311053 Washington State Championship - discussion], mikefrench (Mike French), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (30 June 2008).</ref> He received a Day 2 automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]] from the Federal Way, Washington Mini-Open of 17 August 2008.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 2 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Ryan French (2 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 5]] and [[Virtual Set 27]], sets dated 2009–2026 on this wiki. The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Ryan French|Card Credits]].
